0.title: Aetheric NLP Assistant
0.description: An AI-powered natural language processing tool that performs abstractive summarization, entity recognition, and sentiment classification using lightweight LLM fine-tuning. Built with an interactive streaming dashboard for instant response analysis.

1.title: Nexus Cloud DevOps Control
1.description: A beautiful cloud management console designed for engineering students to monitor Kubernetes clusters, check Docker logs, and deploy static websites using single-click webhooks. Incorporates real-time Prometheus statistics and graphs.

2.title: Synapse Distributed Database
2.description: A lightweight, high-performance in-memory key-value database built from scratch to study TCP/IP sockets, buffer pool management, and index search algorithms. Includes custom clustering replication protocols.
